assumptions: The submitted boundary is an explicitly provisional geometry. Its calculated area is a working value for intake and design comparison, not a precise official scoring area.
This ratio is calculated from the submitted provisional boundary and conceptual building footprints; it is not a statutory building coverage ratio.

floor_area_ratio.reason: Approved FAR controls and official site boundary are not present in the public site package.

assumptions: These are conceptual validation windows, not deployed pilots or procurement approvals.
Cards are conceptual policy interfaces, not enacted regulations, procurement awards or enterprise performance claims.
Persona rows are design viewpoints, not individual profiling or automated decisions.
Nodes are conceptual public markers, not approved structures, heritage alterations or institutional endorsements.
ROAD-001 is a conceptual network alignment inside the provisional boundary, not an engineering centreline or statutory road.
Each connector expresses a required cross-corridor relationship at one key area; final routes depend on official road, rail, river, campus and ownership data.
The network is a conceptual accessibility framework and must be snapped to verified public rights-of-way after professional review.

osm_mapped_station_names_within_800m_cou.formula: count(distinct mapped railway/subway station names within an 800 m projected buffer of the provisional boundary)
assumptions: OpenStreetMap Overpass snapshot accessed 2026-08-08; station names and positions may be incomplete, duplicated, changed or not represent accessible entrances.

osm_mapped_crossing_count.formula: count(OSM nodes tagged highway=crossing inside provisional boundary)
assumptions: This is a mapping completeness screen, not a safety or accessibility rating; every critical crossing requires field audit.

resident_transport_satisfaction_index.formula: weighted mean of resident ratings for walking continuity, crossing safety, cycling comfort, transit transfer, night-time comfort and service access
resident_transport_satisfaction_index.reason: No project-specific resident baseline survey has been completed.

pedestrian_wind_comfort_acceptable_area_.formula: area meeting an approved pedestrian-wind comfort criterion / assessed pedestrian public-space area, reported by season, wind direction and leaf-on/leaf-off state
pedestrian_wind_comfort_acceptable_area_.reason: No calibrated pedestrian-level CFD, local wind boundary conditions or field wind measurements are available.

pollutant_stagnation_hotspot_count.formula: count contiguous pedestrian zones exceeding an approved stagnation or pollutant-removal threshold under specified source and wind scenarios
pollutant_stagnation_hotspot_count.reason: No site emission inventory, PM2.5 time series, air-age analysis or calibrated dispersion model is available.

mean_radiant_temperature_baseline_c.formula: seasonal and time-of-day mean radiant temperature measured along representative pedestrian routes
mean_radiant_temperature_baseline_c.reason: No site mean-radiant-temperature survey or calibrated outdoor thermal-comfort model is available.

continuous_shaded_accessible_route_ratio.formula: length of verified accessible primary route meeting the approved seasonal shade window / total verified accessible primary-route length
continuous_shaded_accessible_route_ratio.reason: The route geometry is provisional and no solar/shade study, tree-crown survey or field accessibility audit has been completed.

blue_green_accessible_route_overlap_rati.formula: length of field-verified accessible primary route within an approved blue-green service distance / total field-verified accessible primary-route length
blue_green_accessible_route_overlap_rati.reason: Submitted layers are conceptual and no field-verified accessible route, blue-space edge or service-distance criterion is available; no health outcome is inferred from proximity.

water_risk_exceedance_route_verified_rat.formula: length of critical accessible route verified outside approved flood-depth and velocity thresholds / total critical accessible-route length under the specified exceedance event
water_risk_exceedance_route_verified_rat.reason: No verified DEM, drainage network, design storm, flood-depth/velocity model or field calibration is available.

resilience_v13_candidate_count.formula: count(explicit design alternatives S0 through S4)
assumptions: Alternatives are normalized decision-support archetypes, not construction schemes or approved projects.

resilience_v13_monte_carlo_draws.formula: deterministic Monte Carlo draws with seed 147228 across five stakeholder profiles, uncertain weights and score noise
assumptions: The draw count and seed are reproducible; the response functions remain explicit design assumptions.
This is a comparative decision score, not a measured climate, drainage, safety or resident outcome.

resilience_v13_selected_p05_score.formula: fifth_percentile(Monte Carlo robust scores for S4_balanced_adaptive)
assumptions: The percentile represents model uncertainty only and excludes unknown site geometry, utility, soil, climate and behavioural uncertainty.

resilience_v13_selected_win_rate.formula: count(draws where S4_balanced_adaptive has highest robust score) / 50000
assumptions: S2_ecology_intensive wins the remaining 21.138% of draws and wins the deterministic climate-first profile.
Low regret supports S4 as a robust compromise; it does not imply S4 is optimal under every climate-only objective.

resilience_v13_selected_min_stress_score.formula: min(eight deterministic design stress scores for S4_balanced_adaptive)
assumptions: Eight stress increments are design tests rather than site-specific forecasts.

resilience_v13_hard_gates_passed.formula: count(pass among minimum core score >=60, minimum stress score >=55, capital intensity <=85, privacy >=80, human score >=75)
assumptions: Gates are pre-field design-screening rules and must be replaced by approved engineering and participatory acceptance criteria.
